semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact registered identity and printed characteristics; Flying; DoubleControllerProliferations; line presentation values; the activation's mana cost, three-counter cost and eligible permanent filter; and one Indestructible counter placed on Source.
A ground-only Coral Merfolk cannot block actual Tekuthal; rejection preserves combat state and command index, while an actual flying Storm Crow can block.

Accepts current activation offers across four tested distributions of three eligible counters and all five configured Phyrexian payment choices; commit pays the selected life and mana, removes the offered counters exactly once, and puts one activation on the stack.

Rejects insufficient life, underfunded mana commit, malformed counter contribution count and stale contribution generation; rejected commands preserve state and command index, and an underfunded commit preserves the accepted pending costs.

Actual Karn's Bastion and Tezzeret's Gambit each produce two successive Proliferate choices under Tekuthal; the selected poison counter is added once per child and each parent ability or spell resolves once.
Pays Ezuri's optional {3} once; Tekuthal produces four Proliferate children; Ezuri's four draw triggers wait until the ETB parent completes, then each draws one card.

Actual Ripples of Potential waits through nested Doubling Season choices for both Tekuthal-produced Proliferate children, unions their distinct permanent receipts, and offers its phase cohort only after both children finish.
An empty first Proliferate child contributes no receipt; the second child's selected permanent is the sole phase recipient.
Two empty Proliferate children complete Ripples without a phase-cohort choice or changes to the permanent's counters.
The actual Tatterkite's counter remains unchanged and the proliferated player is not offered as a permanent phase recipient; Ripples finishes without phasing either.

Liquimetal Coating makes actual Tekuthal an artifact so Krark-Clan Ironworks can sacrifice it during the accepted activation payment window; the pending payment survives, cancellation preserves the sacrifice, and commit spends the locked costs without placing an Indestructible counter on the departed source.

The activation places one Indestructible counter normally, Doubling Season increases placement to two, and an opponent-controlled Vorinclex prevents placement; effective Indestructible matches each counter outcome.
Blossombind prohibits counters on actual Tekuthal; the activation remains usable while Tekuthal is tapped, its mana and three-counter costs are paid, and resolution places no Indestructible counter.
After Tekuthal gains its Indestructible counter, actual Nesting Grounds moves that counter to Grizzly Bears; Murder then destroys Tekuthal while the recipient retains Indestructible.
Tishana's Tidebinder counters the actual activation after its costs are paid; no Indestructible counter is placed, costs remain spent, and Tidebinder removes Tekuthal's abilities.

Prepared-state leave and return preserves the same ObjectId with a newer zone-change generation; the old activation cannot place its counter on the returned incarnation. This fixture is not an ordinary recast line.
